response.overview: The story is an intense action-drama centered around the underworld, power struggles, and vengeance in the capital. Kazi Maruf plays a daring, rebellious protagonist who rises to challenge the reigning criminal empire and syndicates. Purnima stars as the female lead, providing emotional depth and standing by him through the turbulent conflicts. As powerful antagonists (led by Dipjol) try to crush his resistance and establish absolute control, the narrative escalates into a high-octane battle of survival, justice, and the ultimate showdown to become the true protector of the city.
response.title: Dhakar don ( ঢাকার ডন)
